The password-protected PDF is a labelled synthetic error-handling fixture, generated with ReportLab's `StandardEncryption('synthetic-test-password', ownerPassword='synthetic-owner', canPrint=1)` and an invariant canvas. It is not manufacturer documentation and contains no equipment instructions.

The real Advanced archive manual used for browser verification is intentionally not copied into the repository. Its catalogue ID, source URL and SHA-256 are recorded in `research/pdf-repair-0.27.0/README.md`.
